podcast.title: Band Breakup
podcast.body: After their time together, The Stone Poneys eventually broke up, and Linda Ronstadt subsequently launched her solo career. "After The Stone Pony's broke up and Linda went solo, she was given some songs that a newcomer in town, Don Henley, had written and he had hoped that she would record."

podcast.title: Signing with Capitol Records
podcast.body: Following their successful engagement at The Troubadour, The Stone Poneys were signed to a record deal with Capitol Records shortly thereafter. "And then they got her record deal with capital records not long after that."

srcs.episode: Ep. 41 - The Impact of The Troubadour on 1970s Popular Culture

podcast.title: Two-Week Gig at The Troubadour
podcast.body: In 1965, The Stone Poneys, featuring Linda Ronstadt, secured a two-week gig at The Troubadour, which proved to be a pivotal moment for their career. "In 1965, she got a two week gig at the Trubidor with her band The Stone Pony's."
